rows.grounds: first-person singular present active of dhyā (meditate)

items.question: What practice does the meditator undertake during the tapomāsa with undivided mind?
items.inference: The verse prescribes constant meditation during tapomāsa with undivided mind.
uncertainties: Sandhi fusion boundaries are inferred from the fused surface.
The exact ritual sense of iṣṭakṛta remains uncertain.
items.plain_english: I meditate constantly by the desired rite during the tapomāsa with undivided mind.
